title: Part mark
description: The number of a part set large inside a flat Bauhaus shape: a circle, a quarter circle, a half disc or a square.
instructions: One per part opener. number is short (« 01 », « 2 », « A »); label says what it numbers (« Part »). Pick another shape and colour for each part.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the number counts, above it (« Part »).

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: The flat shape behind the number.

colour.title: Colour
colour.description: The colour of the shape (a theme token). The number stays in the ink colour: keep to the light shape colours.
